test_title: PYST 16 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Which sentence contains a misspelled word?

options.text: The colors of the charts should correspond with the data provided in the report.
Please corospond with the client directly to clarify the details.
The two versions do not correspond exactly, so further edits are required.
They agreed to correspond regularly to keep the project on track.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Please corospond with the client directly to clarify the details. .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence in option 2 contains a misspelled word: **corospond**.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **correspond**, which means to communicate by exchanging letters, emails, or messages.
 
• The other options (1, 3, and 4) do not have any spelling errors and use the word "correspond" correctly.

Correct sentence: *Please **correspond** with the client directly to clarify the details.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common spelling mistake:** "corospond" is a common misspelling of "correspond."
 
• **Definition of "correspond":** To communicate by letter, email, or message, or to match or be equivalent to something.
 
• **Example sentences:**
 
 
• We corresponded through email to finalize the details of the agreement.
 
• The colors of the charts correspond with the data provided in the report.
